mainTopic: Labor-pain blood (דם קושי): when it keeps her from being a זבה, according to רב, לוי, רבי מאיר and רבי יהודה
overview: This amud continues the argument between רב and לוי about bleeding that comes with labor pains (דם קושי). The question is when this blood stays טהורה instead of making her a זבה. The גמרא challenges both versions of their argument from רבי מאיר in our משנה, who says labor pains can last forty or fifty days. Each time it answers that the משנה never says she is טהורה the whole time: in ימי נדה she is a נדה, and only in ימי זיבה is she טהורה. Next come two ברייתות that count out long stretches of bleeding with no זיבה: רבי מאיר's 150 days and a shorter 100 days. The חכמים argue that רבי מאיר's count could repeat forever. He answers that the labor-pain rule does not apply to נפלים. The 100-day ברייתא is explained as teaching that a birth can happen without blood. Then the גמרא turns to רבי יהודה, who limits the rule to the final month. רב אדא בר אהבה concludes that the start of the ninth month is what counts. The גמרא challenges this from שמואל's 271 to 273 days and begins answering that שמואל was speaking of the חסידים הראשונים, an answer that continues on the next amud.

steps.title: רב's ruling covers even the new count after a break
steps.stepSummary: The end of רב אדא בר אהבה's explanation of רב: labor-pain blood is טהורה even during days that count as a new count of clean days after a זבה's count was broken.
steps.simpleTranslation: Even during days that are fit for the new counting that follows the breaking of a זבה's count, she remains pure.
steps.whatsHappening: This line finishes רב אדא בר אהבה's explanation of רב's opinion. According to רב, labor-pain blood stays טהורה even during the long stretch of days that follow a broken count.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A זבה must count seven clean days, and any bleeding breaks the count, so she has to start again. Since all those days could become part of a new count, רב treats them like ימי זיבה, and labor-pain blood seen in them is טהורה. This means that according to רב, a woman can stay טהורה for a very long time, which becomes important in the next step.

keyTerms.meaning: Fit for, suitable for
The counting of seven clean days by a זבה
Breaking or cancelling the count by a new sighting of blood
A woman who saw blood for three days during the ימי זיבה

phrases.english: Even days that are fit
for the counting after the breaking of a zava's count.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲפִילּוּ יָמִים הָרְאוּיִין לִסְפִירַת סְתִירַת זָבָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes רב אדא בר אהבה's explanation of רב's opinion, which began just before this line.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רב, labor-pain blood is טהורה both during the ימי זיבה and during any days fit for a new count after a זבה's count was broken.

steps.title: רבי מאיר's forty or fifty days challenges לוי
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes רבי מאיר in the משנה, who says labor pains can last forty or fifty days. That works for רב, but seems impossible for לוי.
steps.simpleTranslation: We learned in the משנה: How long can her labor pains last? רבי מאיר says: forty or fifty days. This makes sense according to רב, because you can explain it the way רב אדא בר אהבה explained him. But according to לוי, it is difficult.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings our משנה, where רבי מאיר says labor pains can last forty or fifty days, and uses it to attack לוי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה seems to say a woman with labor pains can stay טהורה for forty or fifty days. According to רב, as explained in step 1, the טהרה stretches across new counts with no limit, so fifty days is possible. According to לוי, the טהרה only applies during the eleven ימי זיבה, so how can it last fifty days?

keyTerms.meaning: Labor pains, difficult labor before birth
It makes sense according to (one side), but…
You can find a case for it, it is possible
It is difficult, a problem

steps.confusionAlert: The question is not whether labor pains can physically last fifty days. The question is whether she can stay טהורה from that blood for all fifty days according to לוי.

phrases.english: We learned: How long is her labor-pain period?
Rabbi Meir says:
Forty or fifty days.
phrases.notes: Literally 'forty and fifty,' but it means forty or even fifty days before the birth.

phrases.english: Granted according to Rav, you can find it
according to Rav Adda bar Ahava,
but according to Levi, it is difficult.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses רב's wide view from step 1 as a contrast in order to challenge לוי's narrow view.
steps.kashyaTarget: לוי's opinion that labor-pain blood is טהורה only during the ימי זיבה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה allows forty or fifty days of labor pains, which seems to mean fifty days of טהרה. Eleven ימי זיבה cannot cover that.

steps.title: לוי answers that the משנה never said she is pure the whole time
steps.stepSummary: לוי answers that the משנה does not say she is טהורה for all the days. During ימי נדה she is a נדה, and only during ימי זיבה is she טהורה.
steps.simpleTranslation: לוי can tell you: Does the משנה say 'she is pure during all of them'? No. During the days of נדה she is a נדה, and during the days of זיבה she is pure.
steps.whatsHappening: לוי defends himself. He says the משנה only tells us how long labor pains can last, not that she is טהורה for that whole time.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The challenge assumed the משנה meant fifty straight days of טהרה. לוי reads it differently: the fifty days of labor pains pass through both ימי נדה and ימי זיבה. In the ימי נדה the blood makes her a נדה as usual, and in the ימי זיבה it does not make her a זבה, so she is טהורה then.

keyTerms.meaning: Does it teach? A way of saying the source never said that
Pure during all of them
The seven days when blood makes a woman a נדה
The eleven days after the ימי נדה, when blood can make her a זבה

steps.whatToRemember: According to לוי, labor pains can last fifty days, but the blood is only טהורה during the ימי זיבה. During the ימי נדה she is still a נדה. The משנה is only telling us that this blood will not make her a זבה.
steps.whyThisMatters: This shows that the משנה's 'forty or fifty days' measures how long labor pains can count as labor pains. It does not promise a full stretch of טהרה, so both רב and לוי can fit the משנה.

phrases.english: Levi can say to you:
Does it teach 'pure during all of them'?
During the days of niddah, she is a niddah;
during the days of ziva, she is pure.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לָךְ לֵוִי: מִי קָתָנֵי טְהוֹרָה בְּכוּלָּן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of step 2 by reading the משנה differently.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rereading the source: the משנה measures how long labor pains last, not how long she stays טהורה.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: We thought the משנה meant she stays טהורה for all forty or fifty days.
steps.terutzMaskana: She is a נדה during the ימי נדה and טהורה during the ימי זיבה. The משנה only teaches that labor-pain blood does not make her a זבה.

steps.title: Second version: לוי limits the rule to days of a major זבה
steps.stepSummary: In a second version of the argument, רבי לוי says labor-pain blood keeps her טהורה only on days when she could become a זבה גדולה. His source is the פסוק "ימים רבים".
steps.simpleTranslation: Some tell the argument a different way. רבי לוי said: the child makes her טהורה only on days when she could become a major זבה. Why? Because the פסוק says "her blood… many days."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a second version of the argument about when labor-pain blood keeps a woman טהורה. In this version, לוי speaks about a זבה גדולה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A זבה גדולה sees blood three days in a row during the eleven days of זיבה. A זבה קטנה sees blood only one or two days. לוי says the rule that labor blood is טהור only covers bleeding that could make her a זבה גדולה, because the פסוק this rule is learned from speaks of "many days," which describes a זבה גדולה.

keyTerms.meaning: Another version: a different way of reporting the same argument
Makes her טהורה. Here it means the coming birth makes the blood count as labor blood and not as זיבה
A major זבה: a woman who saw blood three days in a row during the days of זיבה
Days that are fit: days when she could become that status

steps.confusionAlert: This is not a new argument. It is the same argument between לוי and רב, told in a different way.

phrases.english: Some say it in another version:
Rabbi Levi said:
The child does not make her pure
except on days that are fit
for her to become a major זבה in them.
phrases.notes: A major זבה is a woman who sees blood three days in a row during the days of זיבה.

phrases.english: What is the reason?
"Her blood… many days" is written.

steps.triggerLanguage: לישנא אחרינא אמרי אמר רבי לוי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a second version of the לוי–רב argument after the first version was challenged and answered.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Labor-pain blood is טהור only on days when she could become a זבה גדולה.

steps.title: רב's view in the second version: even days of a minor זבה
steps.stepSummary: אבא שאול reports that רב says the rule applies even on days when she could become a זבה קטנה. He learns this from the words "ימי" and "כל ימי" in the פסוקים.
steps.simpleTranslation: אבא שאול said in the name of רב: even on days when she could become a minor זבה, the child makes her טהורה. Why? Because the פסוקים there say "days of" and "all the days of."
steps.whatsHappening: Here is רב's side of the second version. He makes the rule wider than לוי does.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רב, the rule is not limited to a זבה גדולה. Labor-pain blood is also טהור when the bleeding could only make her a זבה קטנה. He bases this on the extra wording in the פסוקים, which also covers a זבה קטנה.

keyTerms.meaning: A minor זבה: a woman who saw blood one or two days during the days of זיבה. She keeps one clean day for each day she saw
In the name of: reporting someone else's teaching

phrases.english: Abba Shaul said in the name of Rav:
Even days that are fit
for her to become a minor זבה in them,
What is the reason?
"Days of" and "all the days of" are written there.
phrases.notes: ויקרא 15:25–26. רב reads these extra words as covering the minor זבה too.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives רב's opposing view in the second version, against לוי in step 4.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Labor-pain blood is טהור even on days when she could only become a זבה קטנה.

steps.title: Challenge to both: רבי מאיר's 40–50 days of labor
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings the משנה where רבי מאיר says labor can last forty or fifty days. In this version, that is a problem for both לוי and רב.
steps.simpleTranslation: We learned in the משנה: how long can her labor pains count? רבי מאיר says: even forty or fifty days. This is hard for both of them!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא repeats the challenge from רבי מאיר's משנה. This time it attacks both opinions together.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the second version, both לוי and רב agree that labor blood is טהור only during ימי זיבה. A stretch of forty or fifty days must include ימי נדה too. So the משנה seems to say she stays טהורה even during ימי נדה, and that goes against both of them.

keyTerms.meaning: Labor pains, hard labor before birth
It is difficult for both of them

steps.confusionAlert: In step 2 this same משנה was a problem only for לוי. Now it is a problem for both, because in this version both of them limit the rule.

phrases.english: We learned: how long are her labor pains?
Rabbi Meir says:
Even forty or fifty days.
This is difficult for both of them!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges both opinions of the second version.
steps.kashyaTarget: Both לוי (step 4) and רב (step 5) in the second version
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Forty or fifty days of labor must cover ימי נדה too, but both opinions say labor blood is טהור only during ימי זיבה.

steps.title: Answer: she is not טהורה on all those days
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that the משנה never says she is טהורה the whole time. During ימי נדה she is a נדה, and during ימי זיבה she is טהורה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Does the משנה say "she is pure on all of them"? If her labor pains came during her days of נדה, she is a נדה. If they came during her days of זיבה, she is pure.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the same answer it gave before. It reads the משנה more carefully.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי מאיר only says how long labor pains can last. He does not say she is טהורה for all that time. Labor blood protects her only from becoming a זבה, so during ימי נדה the normal נדה rules still apply.

keyTerms.meaning: Does it teach? A way of saying the source never actually says that
The days of נדה: the seven days when blood makes her a נדה
The days of זיבה: the eleven days between נדה periods, when blood can make her a זבה

steps.whatToRemember: Both versions of the argument end with the same answer. Labor blood only keeps her from becoming a זבה. It does not cancel the status of נדה.

phrases.english: Does it teach "she is pure in all of them"?
If she had labor pains in her days of נדה, she is a נדה,
if in her days of זיבה, she is pure.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 6.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rereading the source: the משנה gives how long labor can last, not how long she is טהורה
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבי מאיר means she is טהורה for all forty or fifty days.
steps.terutzMaskana: She is טהורה only during the ימי זיבה inside that time. During ימי נדה she is a נדה.

steps.title: ברייתא: labor of 150 days without becoming a זבה
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא quotes רבי מאיר: a woman can have labor pains with bleeding for 150 days and never become a זבה. It starts to explain how: first, two days of bleeding outside her normal time.
steps.simpleTranslation: It was taught in a ברייתא: רבי מאיר used to say, there is a woman who has labor pains for one hundred fifty days, and זיבה never comes up in them. How? Two days not at her time…
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא with an even bigger number from רבי מאיר and begins its explanation. Steps 9 and 10 finish the count.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This fits the answer of step 7: long labor is possible, but she is not automatically טהורה the whole time. רבי מאיר describes a pattern where she never becomes a זבה גדולה. The first piece is bleeding on two days during ימי זיבה. That is not her time for נדה, and two days is not enough to make her a זבה גדולה.

keyTerms.meaning: Has labor pains
Literally "goes up". Here it means זיבה status never takes effect
Not at her time, meaning outside the days of נדה, during ימי זיבה

phrases.english: It was taught: Rabbi Meir used to say:
There is a woman who has labor pains for one hundred fifty days,
and זיבה does not take effect during them.
How? Two days not at her time.
phrases.notes: He means two days of bleeding during ימי זיבה, outside the days of נדה. The next steps finish the count.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings another teaching of רבי מאיר about long labor, which fits the answer in step 7.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A woman can have labor pains with bleeding for 150 days without ever becoming a זבה. The explanation begins with two days of bleeding outside her time.

steps.title: The count before the birth: 61 days
steps.stepSummary: רבי מאיר continues his count. After the first 2 days of bleeding come 7 days of נדה, then 2 days after the נדה days, then 50 days of labor in which the child makes her טהורה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And seven days of נדה, and two days after the נדה days, and fifty days in which the child makes her pure.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא continues רבי מאיר's count from step 8. It lists the days before the birth on which her bleeding does not make her a זבה גדולה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A woman becomes a זבה גדולה only if she sees blood on three days in a row during her ימי זיבה. Here she never reaches three: two days of זיבה, then the third day falls in her נדה week, then two more days of זיבה, and on the next day the 50 days of labor begin, when the child protects her. So far: 2 + 7 + 2 + 50 = 61 days.

keyTerms.meaning: The seven days of נדה. Blood seen then makes her a נדה, not a זבה.
After the נדה days, meaning the days of זיבה that follow.
The child makes her pure. Blood from labor pains does not make her a זבה.
A woman who sees blood three days in a row during ימי זיבה.

phrases.english: And seven days of menstruation,
phrases.notes: Her third day of bleeding lands in her נדה week, so she never gets three זיבה days in a row.

phrases.english: and two days after the menstruation,
and fifty in which the child renders her pure.
phrases.notes: These are the 50 days of labor that רבי מאיר mentioned in the משנה from step 6.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְשִׁבְעָה נִדָּה, וּשְׁנַיִם שֶׁל אַחַר הַנִּדָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the day-count that step 8 began.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Before the birth, a woman can bleed for 61 days (2 + 7 + 2 + 50) without becoming a זבה גדולה.

steps.title: The count after the birth: reaching 150 days
steps.stepSummary: After the birth of a girl there are 80 days, then 7 days of נדה, then 2 more days of זיבה. This brings the total to 150.
steps.simpleTranslation: And eighty days of a girl, and seven days of נדה, and two days after the נדה days.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי מאיר finishes his count by adding the days after the birth. The total reaches 150 days with no זיבה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After a girl is born, blood during the 80 days that follow cannot make her a זבה. Then the same pattern as before repeats: 7 days of נדה and 2 days of זיבה, still short of three in a row. 61 + 80 + 7 + 2 = 150, which is the number the ברייתא promised in step 8.

keyTerms.meaning: The 80 days after giving birth to a girl. Blood seen in them does not make her a זבה.
A girl. The count uses a girl because she gives the longest period.

steps.whatToRemember: The 150 days = 2 זיבה + 7 נדה + 2 זיבה + 50 labor + 80 after a girl + 7 נדה + 2 זיבה. Through all of them she never becomes a זבה גדולה.

phrases.english: And eighty days of a female,
and seven days of menstruation,
and two days after the menstruation.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the count started in steps 8 and 9.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Adding 89 days after the birth (80 + 7 + 2) gives a total of 150 days with no זיבה.

steps.title: The חכמים: then she could have labor pains all her life
steps.stepSummary: The חכמים challenge רבי מאיר. If his method works, a woman could keep repeating the cycle and have labor pains her whole life without ever becoming a זבה.
steps.simpleTranslation: They said to him: If so, a woman could have labor pains all her days, and זיבה would never count for her!
steps.whatsHappening: The חכמים attack רבי מאיר's count by stretching it to an extreme. If his method works, it never has to end.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Their point: suppose she becomes pregnant again soon after the birth. The same pattern of נדה days, two זיבה days, labor, and the days after a birth could repeat over and over. That would make a woman who is never a זבה her whole life, which sounds unreasonable.

keyTerms.meaning: Having hard labor pains.
If so. Introduces a strange result that follows from someone's view.
זיבה counts or applies, meaning the bleeding makes her a זבה.

phrases.english: They said to him: If so,
phrases.notes: "They" are the חכמים arguing with רבי מאיר.

phrases.english: there is a woman who has labor pains all her days,
and זיבה is not counted in them!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the 150-day count by showing it could go on without limit.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If labor pains can block זיבה this way, repeated pregnancies could stretch it over a whole lifetime. That is an absurd result.

steps.title: רבי מאיר: labor pains do not count for a non-viable baby
steps.stepSummary: רבי מאיר answers that the endless chain would require babies born too quickly to live (נפלים). Labor pains do not protect her from זיבה for such births.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to them: What are you thinking? Because of נפלים? There is no labor-pain rule for נפלים.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי מאיר answers the חכמים. He explains why his count stops at 150 days and cannot repeat forever.
steps.deeperAnalysis: To keep the cycle going, she would have to become pregnant again and give birth again only a short time later. A baby born after such a short pregnancy is a נפל, a baby that cannot live. The rule that labor blood keeps her טהורה applies only to a real, viable birth, so the chain breaks and the 150 days cannot repeat.

keyTerms.meaning: Non-viable babies, born too early to live.
Hard labor. Here it means the rule that labor blood does not make her a זבה.
What are you thinking? Asks what the other side is basing their point on.

steps.whatToRemember: The labor-pain rule (קושי) protects her only for a real, viable birth, not for נפלים. That is why רבי מאיר's count stops at 150 days.

phrases.english: He said to them: What is your thinking?
Because of non-viable babies?
phrases.notes: Only a very early birth could make the cycle repeat. A baby born that early cannot live.

phrases.english: There is no labor-pain rule for non-viable babies.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the חכמים' challenge from step 11.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limits the rule: the labor-pain protection does not apply to non-viable births.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The חכמים thought the labor-pain rule works for any birth, so the cycle could repeat forever.
steps.terutzMaskana: Labor pains protect her only for a viable baby. A birth soon enough to repeat the cycle would be a נפל, so the chain stops.

steps.title: A woman can see blood for 100 days without becoming a זבה
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא counts out 100 days of bleeding in which she never becomes a זבה: 2 + 7 + 2 + 80 + 7 + 2.
steps.simpleTranslation: The רבנן taught: A woman can see blood for 100 days and never become a זבה. How? She bleeds 2 days outside her normal time, then 7 days of נדה, then 2 days after the נדה days. Then she has a girl, which gives 80 days, then 7 days of נדה, then 2 days after the נדה days.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a new ברייתא with a shorter count than רבי מאיר's 150 days. This one adds up to 100 days of bleeding with no זיבה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: To become a זבה she must bleed 3 days in a row during the days of זיבה, so each stretch of זיבה days here has only 2 days of bleeding. After the 2 days of זיבה that follow her נדה week, she gives birth to a girl on the next day. That gives her 80 days in which her bleeding does not make her a זבה. Unlike רבי מאיר's count, there are no 50 days of labor pains here.

keyTerms.meaning: The status of a זבה, from bleeding outside the נדה days
Not at her normal time, meaning outside her expected period
The 7 days of the regular period
A girl, here meaning the birth of a girl

phrases.english: The Rabbis taught:
There is a woman who sees blood for one hundred days,
and זיבה does not count in them.
How? Two days not at her time,
and seven days of נדה,
and two days after the נדה days,
and eighty days of a girl,
and seven days of נדה,
and two days after the נדה days.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: יֵשׁ רוֹאָה מֵאָה יוֹם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A parallel ברייתא with a shorter count that leaves out the labor-pain days
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A woman can see blood for 100 days and never become a זבה: 2+7+2+80+7+2.

steps.title: What is this ברייתא teaching?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what new point the 100-day ברייתא is making.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is it teaching us?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks what the new lesson of this ברייתא is. It is setting up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The count seems to be simple math, so the גמרא wants to know what new law is hiding inside it.

keyTerms.meaning: What is it teaching us? (asking for the new point)

phrases.english: What is it teaching us?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the purpose of the ברייתא just quoted
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What new law the 100-day count is teaching

steps.title: A birth can happen without blood
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא disagrees with the view that a birth always comes with blood. It teaches that the womb can open without blood.
steps.simpleTranslation: It comes to reject the one who says the womb cannot open without blood. It teaches us that the womb can open without blood.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the ברייתא is teaching that a woman can give birth without bleeding.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the count, she gives birth right after 2 days of זיבה bleeding. If every birth came with blood, the birth would add a third day of bleeding and she would be a זבה. Since the ברייתא says she is not a זבה, it must hold that a birth can happen with no blood.

keyTerms.meaning: To exclude, meaning to reject a different opinion
The opening of the womb, meaning the birth
It is impossible

steps.whatToRemember: The 100-day ברייתא teaches that a birth can happen without blood. So giving birth on the third day of זיבה does not automatically make her a זבה.

phrases.english: To exclude the one who says

phrases.aramaic: אִי אֶפְשָׁר לִפְתִיחַת הַקֶּבֶר בְּלֹא דָּם,
phrases.english: it is impossible for the womb to open without blood,
phrases.notes: Literally 'the grave.' Here it is a name for the womb.

phrases.english: it teaches us
that it is possible for the womb to open without blood.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 14
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The ברייתא rejects the view that every birth comes with blood. It holds that a birth can happen without blood.

steps.title: רבי יהודה: labor pains protect only within her month
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes רבי יהודה from the משנה and brings a ברייתא in the name of רבי טרפון. Labor pains only protect her from זיבה within her final month, and this rule has both a lenient side and a strict side.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: רבי יהודה says, it is enough, etc. A ברייתא teaches: רבי יהודה says in the name of רבי טרפון, it is enough for her within her month. The rule has a side that is lenient and a side that is strict.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to a new part of the משנה, the opinion of רבי יהודה. It brings a ברייתא that explains his opinion.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי מאיר gave labor pains protection for many days. רבי יהודה limits it: only bleeding with labor pains in her final month is protected from זיבה. The ברייתא adds that this limit can sometimes help her and sometimes hurt her.

keyTerms.meaning: It is enough for her within her month, meaning her final month of pregnancy
To be lenient and to be strict
Etc., meaning the quote continues in the משנה

phrases.english: רבי יהודה says: it is enough, etc.

phrases.aramaic: תַּנְיָא: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי טַרְפוֹן:
phrases.english: It was taught: רבי יהודה says in the name of רבי טרפון:
It is enough for her within her month,
and the matter has a lenient side and a strict side.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to the next opinion in the משנה, רבי יהודה
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Labor pains protect her from זיבה only within her final month. This can be either lenient or strict.

steps.title: The strict side: bleeding that started in the eighth month
steps.stepSummary: Suppose she had labor pains with bleeding for 2 days at the end of the eighth month and 1 day at the start of the ninth. Even if she gave birth in the ninth month, she is a woman who gives birth as a זבה.
steps.simpleTranslation: How so? If she had labor pains for two days at the end of the eighth month and one day at the start of the ninth, then even if she gave birth at the start of the ninth, she is a woman who gives birth as a זבה.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא gives the first example, the strict side of רבי יהודה's rule.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The 2 days in the eighth month fall outside her month, so the labor pains do not protect them. The ברייתא says the day in the ninth month joins them, which makes 3 days, so she is a זבה. The words 'even if she gave birth' show that giving birth in the ninth month still does not save her.

keyTerms.meaning: She had hard labor pains
A woman who gives birth while she is a זבה
The ninth month

steps.confusionAlert: Do not assume that a day of labor pains in the ninth month is always protected. When the bleeding began in the eighth month, the ninth-month day joins the earlier days and makes her a זבה.

phrases.english: How so? She had labor pains for two days at the end of the eighth month
phrases.notes: These are labor pains together with bleeding.

phrases.english: and one day at the start of the ninth month,
and even if she gave birth at the start of the ninth month,
she is a woman who gives birth as a זבה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains the strict side mentioned in step 16
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Two days in the eighth month plus one day in the ninth make her a woman who gives birth as a זבה, even if she gave birth in the ninth month.

steps.title: The lenient side: most of the bleeding falls in the ninth month
steps.stepSummary: This finishes the ברייתא. If she bled with labor pains 1 day at the end of the eighth month and 2 days at the start of the ninth, she is not a woman who gives birth as a זבה, even if she gave birth at the end of the ninth.
steps.simpleTranslation: But if she had labor pains for one day at the end of the eighth month and two days at the start of the ninth, then even if she gave birth at the end of the ninth month, she is not a woman who gives birth as a זבה.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא now gives the lenient side of רבי יהודה's rule. It flips the case from step 17.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Bleeding with labor pains in the ninth month is protected, so those 2 days do not count toward זיבה. That leaves only 1 day of unprotected bleeding in the eighth month, which is not enough to make her a זבה. It does not matter that the birth itself came much later, at the end of the ninth month.

keyTerms.meaning: She had labor pains (birth pangs)
The end of the eighth month of pregnancy
The beginning of the ninth month of pregnancy

steps.whatToRemember: For רבי יהודה, the question is which month the labor pains fall in, not when the baby is actually born. Pains in the ninth month protect her. Pains before the ninth month do not.

phrases.aramaic: אֲבָל קִשְּׁתָה יוֹם אֶחָד בְּסוֹף שְׁמִינִי
phrases.english: But if she had labor pains one day at the end of the eighth [month]
and two [days] at the beginning of the ninth,
then even if she gave birth at the end of the ninth —
this is not a woman who gives birth as a זבה.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲבָל קִשְּׁתָה יוֹם אֶחָד בְּסוֹף שְׁמִינִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the lenient case that matches the strict case in step 17.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Bleeding with labor pains in the ninth month does not count toward זיבה, even if the birth comes much later.

steps.title: The start of the ninth month is what protects her
steps.stepSummary: רב אדא בר אהבה learns from the ברייתא that, for רבי יהודה, the start of the ninth month (the 'shofar' of the new month) is what makes her bleeding protected.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אדא בר אהבה said: Learn from this that רבי יהודה holds that the shofar causes it.
steps.whatsHappening: רב אדא בר אהבה draws a rule out of the ברייתא. Once the ninth month begins, bleeding with labor pains is linked to the coming birth.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the ברייתא, the line between protected and unprotected bleeding falls exactly where the ninth month begins. So the start of the new month is what switches the protection on. This suggests the whole ninth month counts as a possible time for birth.

keyTerms.meaning: Learn from this (we can conclude)
He holds (this is his view)
Literally 'the shofar causes': the start of the new month is what makes the difference

phrases.english: Rav Adda bar Ahava said:
Learn from this that Rabbi Yehuda holds
the shofar causes [it].
phrases.notes: The 'shofar' stands for the start of the new month. Once the ninth month begins, her bleeding with labor pains is protected.

steps.triggerLanguage: שְׁמַע מִינַּהּ קָסָבַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה שִׁיפּוּרָא גָּרֵים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws a general rule from the two cases in steps 17 and 18.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: For רבי יהודה, the start of the ninth month is what makes bleeding with labor pains protected from זיבה.

steps.title: שמואל says birth comes only after 271 to 273 days
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the idea that the whole ninth month counts as time for birth. שמואל said a woman gives birth only after 271, 272, or 273 days.
steps.simpleTranslation: Is that so? But didn't שמואל say: A woman does not become pregnant and give birth except at 271 days, or 272 days, or 273 days!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks רב אדא בר אהבה's conclusion using a statement of שמואל.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If birth happens only after about nine full months, then early in the ninth month birth is not yet expected. So why should the start of the ninth month already protect her bleeding? שמואל's numbers seem to clash with treating the whole ninth month as birth time.

keyTerms.meaning: Is that so? (opens a challenge)
But surely... (brings a source that seems to contradict)
Becomes pregnant

phrases.english: Is that so?
But didn't Shmuel say:
A woman does not become pregnant and give birth
except after 271 days,
or after 272 days,
or after 273!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the conclusion of step 19.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב אדא בר אהבה's claim that the start of the ninth month already counts as birth time.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: שמואל fixes birth at 271 to 273 days, which is after the full nine months. So the early part of the ninth month should not be treated as birth time.

steps.title: שמואל was describing the early pious men
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that שמואל's numbers follow the practice of the חסידים הראשונים, who had marital relations only on Wednesday so that their wives would not come... (the reason continues in the next part).
steps.simpleTranslation: He said it according to the early pious men, as it was taught in a ברייתא: The early pious men would have marital relations only on the fourth day of the week, so that their wives would not come...
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge. It limits שמואל's statement to a special group, the חסידים הראשונים, and starts quoting a ברייתא about them. The quote continues past this point.
steps.deeperAnalysis: שמואל's exact count is not a rule for every woman. It fits people who carefully timed their marital relations, so their wives' birth dates came out in a predictable range. That leaves room for רבי יהודה's view that, in general, birth can come anytime in the ninth month.

keyTerms.meaning: The early pious men of earlier generations
Have marital relations
The fourth day of the week (Wednesday)

phrases.english: He said it according to the early pious men,
as it was taught in a ברייתא:

phrases.aramaic: חֲסִידִים הָרִאשׁוֹנִים לֹא הָיוּ מְשַׁמְּשִׁין מִטּוֹתֵיהֶן
phrases.english: The early pious men would not have marital relations
except on the fourth day of the week,
so that their wives would not come

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge from שמואל in step 20.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Limits the source: שמואל's numbers describe only a special group, not all women.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: שמואל's 271 to 273 days is a rule for every pregnancy, so the early ninth month is not birth time.
steps.terutzMaskana: שמואל was speaking about the חסידים הראשונים, who timed their marital relations. This leaves room for the whole ninth month to be possible birth time.
